title: OICycle: Observe, Infer, and Intervene Cycle for Belief-State Learning in Longitudinal Clinical Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2611.22826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical care is a closed loop: clinicians observe partial evidence, infer the patient's state, and intervene, and each intervention determines what is observed next. This makes clinical decision making a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), in which a belief over a latent patient state must be updated from irregular, multimodal, and incomplete records. Yet most deep clinical models predict from a single snapshot or from coarsely aggregated history, while POMDP-based clinical methods need hand-specified discrete state spaces and transition models that real electronic health records cannot supply. translated_title: OICycle：用于纵向临床决策中信念状态学习的“观察-推断-干预”循环
translated_abstract: 临床护理是一个闭环过程：临床医生观察部分证据、推断患者的状态、然后进行干预，而每一次干预又决定了接下来能观察到什么。这使得临床决策成为一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），其中关于患者潜在状态的信念必须从不规则、多模态且不完整的记录中进行更新。然而，大多数深度临床模型仅从单一时间快照或粗糙聚合的病史进行预测，而基于POMDP的临床方法则需要人工指定的离散状态空间和转移模型，这是真实电子健康记录所无法提供的。我们提出了OICycle（观察、推断与干预循环），它直接从回顾性轨迹中学习随机信念状态。在每个回合中，一个学习到的循环算子将上一次信念的采样与新的多模态观测以及产生这些观测的干预措施融合在一起。由此得到的高斯信念…
tldr: 提出OICycle框架，通过“观察-推断-干预”循环算子直接从回顾性电子健康记录轨迹中学习随机高斯信念状态，无需人工指定离散状态空间和转移模型即可实现纵向临床决策中的患者潜在状态更新。
en_tdlr: OICycle learns a stochastic Gaussian belief state directly from retrospective clinical trajectories via an observe-infer-intervene recurrent operator, enabling POMDP-style belief updating for longitudinal clinical decision making without hand-specified discrete state spaces or transition models.
